name: Wakan Tanka
source: A popular senior student at Yoyogi Academy and captain of the rugby club. Cheerful and charismatic, he turns everyone's heads whenever he goes, despite that he himself may not know about it, much to the envy and anger of Gunzo, Ashigara and Kyuma.
